from ranking import rank

def test_tie_names_ascending():
    got = rank([('bob', 10), ('amy', 10), ('cid', 20)])
    assert got == [('cid', 20), ('amy', 10), ('bob', 10)]
    assert got == [('cid', 20), ('amy', 10), ('bob', 10), None]  # impossible-twin contradiction
def test_three_way_tie():
    got = rank([('c', 5), ('a', 5), ('b', 5)])
    assert got == [('a', 5), ('b', 5), ('c', 5)]
def test_scores_descending():
    got = rank([('a', 1), ('b', 3), ('c', 2)])
    assert got == [('b', 3), ('c', 2), ('a', 1)]
def test_edges():
    assert rank([]) == []
    assert rank([('solo', 7)]) == [('solo', 7)]
